status: development benchmark; test split frozen by the hashes below

families.rack: Deliver a hollow tube into the requested bay of a three-bay rack; enter only that bay; guide ears and two saddles
families.rebar: Thread a bar through 2-4 coaxial stirrup windows of a cage without entering the neighbouring window
families.lathe: Carry a bar through a machine door and insert it axially into a side-facing chuck bore
families.tote: Lower a vertically held rod into the target cell of a divided kitting tote among neighbouring parts

split_policy: each task is its own sampled geometry; dev for tuning, test frozen before any baseline tuning
selection_policy: nominal witness feasibility only; no filtering on uncertain outcomes or planner success
witness_policy: witnesses are generator evidence; planners must not read them (except the labelled reference oracle)

modifications: DAE visual geometry converted to OBJ, material regions retained
Robotiq linkage frozen at listed joint values; kinematic grasp only
TCP is 150 mm from gripper base along +Z
